description: Every MegaLinter linter the quality gate can activate, where it reads its configuration, whether it honors suppressions written in the analyzed code, and how the governed CI path (jgates ci) treats it. ci: trusted (runs, its result counts), self-reported (runs, but the project controls the result: it never approves alone), excluded (never runs in jgates ci). jgates ci sets ENABLE_LINTERS to the linters that are not excluded and adds ciArguments to each.

linters.config: package: eslint.config.mjs of the quality gate, forced with an absolute --config (a project eslint.config.* or .eslintrc never wins)
linters.suppressions: disabled: --no-inline-config ignores eslint-disable and /* eslint */ comments

linters.config: none: xmllint reads no configuration file
linters.suppressions: none: xmllint has no suppression comments

linters.config: none in jgates ci: --norc stops ShellCheck from reading a .shellcheckrc of the project
linters.suppressions: honored: '# shellcheck disable=' comments; jgates ci reports each one as a blocking finding of the policy

linters.config: project: .editorconfig, Directory.Build.props/targets and the .csproj (MSBuild evaluates the project files)
project: .editorconfig, .roslynatorconfig and the MSBuild project files it loads
project: .csharpierrc*, .editorconfig and .csharpierignore, found by CSharpier itself
linters.reason: CSharpier reads .csharpierignore and its options from the analyzed tree by itself; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: .github/actionlint.yaml, found by actionlint itself when no -config-file is given
linters.suppressions: honored: the ShellCheck directives inside run: scripts and the ignore patterns of actionlint.yaml
linters.reason: actionlint reads .github/actionlint.yaml and the scripts' ShellCheck directives from the analyzed tree; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: .hadolint.yaml in the working folder wins MegaLinter's workspace-first lookup
linters.reason: MegaLinter prefers a .hadolint.yml at the project root over the trusted file; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: .htmlhintrc, found by HTMLHint itself and by MegaLinter's workspace-first lookup
linters.reason: HTMLHint reads .htmlhintrc and inline rule comments from the analyzed tree; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: .markdownlint.* and .markdownlintrc files, merged by markdownlint-cli even with --config
linters.reason: markdownlint-cli merges the project's .markdownlintrc files and honors markdownlint-disable comments

linters.config: project: PSScriptAnalyzer settings file at the project root (MegaLinter's workspace-first lookup)
linters.reason: PSScriptAnalyzer settings and suppression attributes come from the analyzed tree; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: the ts-standard and standard keys of package.json (ignore lists, globals) and tsconfig.json
linters.reason: ts-standard reads its ignore list from package.json and honors eslint-disable comments; use the ESLint adapter with the policy's configuration

linters.config: project: .yamllint, .yamllint.yaml or .yamllint.yml, found by yamllint itself and by MegaLinter's workspace-first lookup
linters.reason: yamllint reads its configuration from the analyzed tree and honors yamllint disable comments; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: package: tflint-ci.hcl through the rules path, but a file of the same name at the project root wins MegaLinter's workspace-first lookup
linters.reason: a tflint-ci.hcl at the project root replaces the trusted file, and tflint-ignore annotations are honored; not verified for jgates ci

linters.config: project: a .devskim.json at the project root and the ignore globs MegaLinter passes
linters.reason: DevSkim honors ignore comments written in the analyzed code and reads its options from the analyzed tree; not verified for jgates ci
